# HyperspectralGraphTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A graph representation where hyperspectral image pixels are nodes and edges encode spectral similarity or spatial adjacency, forming a topology for classification tasks. Provides a natural topological abstraction for high-dimensional spectral data, enabling graph-based learning in TCC pipelines.
